STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: looks like a square dinner plate, roughly 20-30 cm. The photo shows a fairly large plate relative to the food.
b) Reference: the bread/flatbread piece at lower left is about 11 cm across and the tomato slices are roughly 6-7 cm. Across the plate width (~the full image width of the plate), the plate spans about 2.5 to 2.7 flatbread-lengths, giving roughly 26-28 cm.
Reconciling the two cues: width ≈ 26 cm.
